tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rta mgrin nag po zla rgyal lugs kyi gtor zlog rdo rje'i me char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bdud dpung phye mar 'thag byed pa'i// bla ma rta mchog rol pa la// btud nas gdug can sgrol byed pa'i// las rim rdo rje'i me char spro// de'ang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi bka' srol las byon pa'i bcom ldan rta mgrin nag po la brten nas drag po gtor zor gyi las rim bgyi ba 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po ni/ sgrub khang rnying pa sogs mtshan nyid ldan par stegs kyi khar 'di'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung gi mdun du yi dam gyi gtor zlum dang*/ chos skyong gur zhal gyi gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ nyer spyod bcas bsham/ de'i mdun ngos su zlog dkyil gzhi nag por gru gsum dmar nag me ris bskor ba'i dbus su nyi gdan la tshon spungs nag po bkod/ de'i steng du mañtsi'i khar lcags snod du dpal gtor zur gsum dmar nag me ri'i rgyan ldan zur mdun bstan gyi mthar khrag kong*/ mtshe yungs/ rtsangs/ rgyu lding*/ sha rdzar gyis brgyan pa'i rtser lha tsag dar nag gi gdugs phub pa/ de'i mdun zor gtor gru gsum chung ba me ri can theb kyu yungs rtsangs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi rol tu 'bul gtor chung du re bcas thams cad khrag gis sbags shing mtshe yangs btsugs pa/ dug sna sogs thun rdzas/ mtha' skor du sman raka gtor ma drag mchod kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ tshogs 'khor/ 'brub khung liṅga/ gser skyems/ logs gang bder brtan ma'i gtor ma/ yungs thun/ gu gul/ 'thor nas/ rdor dril/ phur pa/ sgrol gri/ g.yab dar/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad legs par bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sgrub pa po stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dkar gtor ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ sarba lo ka pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mgron dgug sarba lo ka pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don du gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes gtor ma phyi rol tu 'bul lo// mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ gyis chos rnams stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// āḥlas dung chen thod pa yangs pa'i nang*// hūm̐ las phyi nang dgra bgegs bsgral byung gi// khrag zhag yon chab dbang lnga'i me tog dang*// tshil chen spos dang zhun chen mar me gsal// mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas ri// rkang gling rnga dung rol mo bsam mi khyab// bdud rtsi sman mchog rak+ta'i rgya mtsho che// sha rus brtsegs pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga// dpag yas mchod sprin zhing kun khyab par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis nyer spyod dang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ zhes pas bdud rtsi dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ zhes pas rak+ta dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ zhes pas gtor ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa swā hā/ zhes pas mchod pa thams cad mi zad par byin gyis brlab bo// de nas skyabs yul gsal btab la/

bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro nyer gcig las mi nyung ba'i mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rta mgrin bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis rta mgrin du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyud dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod do// snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems de nyid hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren steng gdon 'og gdon la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad sbyangs/ rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus te hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdig mdzub dang bcas pas nad gdon sreg pa'i me'i phung po rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/

zhal mche ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs yod pa gtsigs shing g.yon du rngams pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar zhing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ spyi bo nas rta mgo sngo ljang thon zhing rta skad kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbur brgyan pa/ bram ze'i rigs dmar pos mgul pa brgyan pa/ rje'u rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol pa'i rigs nag pos ga shal/ dmangs rigs ser pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal la sogs pa dpa' bo'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ khro gnyer shin tu gnyer zhing rab tu 'jigs par byed pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sku lus sbom la thung ba/ ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ mchod pa gong ltar bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams bsgom mo// rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥ'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bskor ba/

de dag las 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren/ steng gdon gza' dang*/ 'og gdon klu dang*/ bar gdon btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par zhal nas 'thon te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par bsam/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sarba tsit+ta kā la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṛh+ṇa rā dza rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren sogs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang zhes sogs nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gong bdag bskyed bzhin la bdag mdun gyi tshig kha bsgyur/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbyangs rol dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// brjod med chos nyid don las ma g.yos kyang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du// brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ

hūm̐/ 'jig rten rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khri steng na// ru dra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rngam brjid ngar dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku// sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes byon par bsam/ oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā re oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs pa dang*/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsgom pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur zhes bsgyur ro// de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la/ phyi mchod ni/ hrīḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal zhugs tog sgra// zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang*// rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ mtheb srin sbyar bas nang mchod 'thor la/ hrīḥrang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol ba'i// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas la// bdag cag dang bas 'bul lags kyi// thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

snga rabs 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*// slad nas 'byon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes dgongs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan sogs// rta mgrin nag po'i brgyud pa'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi= /thugs rjes dgongs la= /oṃ sarba pañtsa= gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku// khams gsum dbang sdud bcom ldan he ru kar// rnam dag bdud rtsi= /thugs rjes dgongs la= /oṃ sarba pañtsa= gnas gsum dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi= /thugs rjes dgongs la= /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rang gi gnas gsum du thig le byas la/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ gsang ba rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rak+ta dmar chen mchod pa 'di// rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sbyor mchod ni/ hūm̐/ gsang ba thabs dang shes rab las// pad+ma nor bu mnyam sbyor nas// dgyes pa chen po'i bde chen dang*// byang chub sems kyi mchod pa ni// rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta swā hā/ bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis// zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang*// 'khor ba nyon mongs rgya dral nas// dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya'o// a mu ke mā ra ya phaṭa/ hūm̐/ zhing gyur thams cad rang bzhin bsgral// sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di// rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// ma hā māṃ sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i tshogs// sha khrag keng rus gtor ma 'dis// khro rgyal rta mchog thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi// khyad par= /sha khrag= /chos skyong srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐/ sha khrag rus pa nang khrol mkhris// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal phrag dog mchod par 'bul// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las dngos por bzhes su gsol// ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar// phyag na mdzes sdug longs spyod bsnams// dbang chen lha yi spyan la 'bul// gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dges par mdzod// sgra yi lha mo sku mdog sngo// phyag na sgra snyan longs spyod= /dbang chen lha yi snyan= sgra yi mchod pa= /a la la= /dri yi lha mo sku mdog ser// phyag na dri yi= /dbang chen lha yi shangs= /dri yi mchod= /a la la= /ro yi lha mo sku mdog dmar// phyag na ro yi= /dbang chen lha yi ljags= /ro yi= /a la la= /reg bya'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*// phyag na reg bya'i= /dbang chen lha yi sku= reg bya'i mchod= /a la la= /chos kyi lha mo sku mdog mthing*// phyag na chos kyi po ti bsnams// dbang chen lha yi thugs la 'bul// chos kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dges par mdzod// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo las// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku// gsung mchog rta skad 'tsher bas gdug pa 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'gyur med rtogs pas sku mdog nag /shes rab ral gri 'phyar bas 'khor ba gcod// g.yon na me phung bsnams pas bdud rnams sreg

/'jigs byed drag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// srid gsum sreg mdzad spyan gsum me phung 'phro// smin ma glog stong ma rig mun pa 'joms// gshin rje khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gtsigs// rnam thar brgyad ldan dpal gyis chas brgyad gsol// zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad pas bdud rnams 'joms// dbang chen khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gag med pad+ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyer med brtse ba'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥ'i mthar sogs gong ltar bzlas dmigs la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag ste/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sarba tsit+ta kā la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṛh+ṇa rā dza rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ de nas zlog pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid dbang chen gsal ba'i thugs ka yi// hrīḥlas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed lha tshogs kyi// thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul ba spu yi// bu ga kun nas khro chung nyi zer gyi// rdul ltar 'phros pas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// gnod byed pha rol rbod gtong mkhan po dang*// dug mtshon g.yul sogs bsam sbyor ngan rtsom pa'i// gzugs can dgra dang rbad 'dre lha ma srin// sde brgyad 'byung po spyi dang bye brag sogs// lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal gtong*// bsam par bar gcod chags che nyam nga g.yo// mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs rtsom pa'i// gzugs med bgegs rnams thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog /rnam shes bla tshe srog dbugs bcas pa rnams// dmigs rten gzugs kyi nya bo 'di nyid la// rang dbang med par bkug nas thim par gyur// rtsa sngags mjug tu/

rbad ta ya rbad ta ya lo ka rbad ta ya phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha zlog zlog ces dmigs pa dang bcas ci nus su bzla/ mthar yungs kar nag dug khrag la phus btab ste zlog gtor la brab cing bskul/ de nas gtor zor la dmigs te/ rang nyid dbang chen gsal ba'i thugs ka yi// hrīḥlas 'od 'phros gtor zor la phog pas// dbang chen rol pa'i khro bo skar ltar 'khrugs// mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug lta bu ru// 'tshubs shing 'phros pas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// gnod byed pha rol rbod gtong mkhan po sogs gong bzhin brjod rjes/ gong rtsa sngags sham bur sarba pā paṃ sarba du tri mā ra ya zlog zlog bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ zhes ci nus bzlas te thun gyis brab/ dzab bstod bya ba ni/ bcom ldan rta mchog he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal nag po ni// dbang drag stobs chen rngams chen gtum// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rta skad 'tsher// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrogs// dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud// dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ khro rgyal rngam pa rta mchog dpal// dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las// mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol// gong gi rtsa sngags bdun nam nyer gcig tsam bzla/ gtor mar chab bran la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod bcom ldan 'das rta mchog rol pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/

hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+yā āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo las// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku// gsung mchog rta skad 'tsher bas 'gro ba 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud skul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// yang gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis brlabs nas/ gur lha brgyad zhal mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bcas gtor chog mdzes rgyan bzhin dang*/ spro na chos srung gi skang gso skabs su bab pa btang*/ de nas tshogs mchod ni/ tshogs rdzas bshams la chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs te/ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ/ tshogs rdzas ma dag pa'i dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tshogs gzhong bh+rūm̐ las rin po che dang pad+ma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ tshogs rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i 'dod yon rnam lnga'i phung po phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bde chen lha mo'i rol pa dang bcas pa/ 'dod rgu rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter rnam par dag par gyur/ oṃ ma hā rat+na ka pā la bi shud+dha hūm̐/ lan gsum/ spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las// sprul pa'i khro bo mi bzad pa// bcom ldan rta mgrin nag po'i lha// longs spyod tshogs la gshegs su gsol/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wā na badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥpad+ma karma lā ya s+t+waṃ/

bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ dhū paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yāṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ tshogs phud rim pa gsum las/ dang po tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ phun sum 'dod yon lnga rdzogs zhal zas kyi// tshogs chen ri ltar spungs pa bla ma dang*// yi dam dbang chen rta mgrin nag po la// 'bul lo bzhes nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha raṃ khā hi/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ thugs rje che dgongs tshe rabs thog med nas// da lta'i bar du chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis/ kun nas bslangs pa'i sdig ltung ci bsags pa// longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pas mthol zhing bshags// badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a/ yi ge brgya pa brjod do// de nas gtor chung bshams la/ hrīḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// pad+ma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du// rnam shes gnas gyur pad+ma he ru ka /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dang*// rgyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa// khro rgyal rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus dang*// bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung tshogs rab bskyed nas// bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las dus la bab// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la// pha rol ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad dang*// snang srid lha 'dre'i gnod 'tshe za kha zug /dus min 'chi dang nad gdon keg ngan sri// mi kha bra mchu dug mtshon g.yul gshom sogs// chag che nyam nga bar chad ma lus pa// byad ma mkhan dang log 'dren dgra bgegs kyi// steng du zlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing 'byor drug 'phel ba dang*// mos bzhi dbang sdud gnod byed ma lus pa// bsad bskrad rengs rmongs sogs kyis tshar bcad nas// phrin las rnam bzhi ma lus sgrub par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol lo// tshogs tha ma'i sngon skul gyi rim pa la/

rig 'dzin spyi bskul ni/ bcom ldan rta mgrin zla ba rgyal mtshan dang*// skyo tsha 'od dang grub chen dbu dkar ba// zhang pa lo tsā byang sems rin chen dang*// rgyal ba grub pa'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs// chos rje 'dzin pa spang sgang rin po che// rin chen brtson 'grus byang chub seng ge'i zhabs// sa bzang 'phags pa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// bsod nams rgyal mtshan tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs// bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel// lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge nas// khyab bdag kun dga'i bar du byon pa dang*// pad+ma dbang chen dbyer med mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// de dag kun kyang theg pa so so yi// gang la sbyangs pa'i yon tan khyad par can// mi yi lus kyi sangs rgyas rin po che// rkang gnyis mchog gyur tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yi// mngon spyod phrin las sgrub pa'i thugs dam rgyud// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig gnyen pos skul ba'i dus la bab// dkon mchog spyi skul ni/ pad+ma dbang chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na// bcom ldan rta mgrin nag po'i lha tshogs dang*// dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams ni// mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs la byin gyis rlobs// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i// rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin pho mo'i tshogs// mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs la byin gyis rlobs// rtsi shing thams cad ye nas sman dang bcud// snang srid thams cad ye nas byang chub sems// stong gsum thams cad ye nas gzhal yas khang*// rgyud drug thams cad ye nas rgyal ba'i sku// sgra dbyangs thams cad drag po'i sngags kyi tshig /ma sring srung ma ye nas bran dang g.yog /rbad cing mngags so dam can thugs dam can// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gang ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod// nga dpal khrag 'thung he ru ka

/'jig rten thams cad bsgral ba'i zhing*// bza' btung thams cad sha khrag tshogs// gzugs snang thams cad khro bo'i sku// dbang chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// khro bo dmar nag stong gsum bkang*// gnam lcags thog gi ral pa can// spyan mig nyi zla me chu 'bar// shangs nas nad dang rlung tshub 'gyed// zhal nas gnam lcags zhun mar 'thor// mtshon cha sna tshogs ba spu can// lcags kyus 'dzin zhing zhags pas 'ching*// yid la brnags pa'i dgra bgegs kyi// lus srog 'tsho ba'i lha dang phrol// dpag tshad tsam nas sdebs su chug /'dom gang tsam nas myos su chug /khru gang tsam nas brgyal du chug /mtho gang tsam nas brlag par gyis// bla srog drangs te gzugs la stims// liṅga 'di la shed cig chug /rings par khug la myur du sgrol// rnam shes dbang po rten dang phrol// pags pa bshus la nang khrol thon// mgo dang yan lag bregs la shog /glo snying phyung la lhu gzugs phrol// sha zo khrag 'thungs rus pa 'chos// bdun brgyud rtsa ba chod la shog /ming yang med par brlag par gyis// byang chub sems ni ma skyes na// yun du nam yang gtang mi bya// byang sems skyes na gtang bar bya// skabs 'dir tshogs tha ma dang ling gzugs la bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ yi dam bskul ba ni/ hrīḥ rang bzhin chos kyi sku las rang byung ba// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// drag gtum khro bo rta mchog rol pa'i sku// thugs rjes thabs kyi sprul sku bzhengs su gsol// bdud po bdud mo byi chings bsnol ba'i khri// chags med pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng nas// dus gsum dbang bsgyur ye shes lha yi lha// dbang chen khrag 'thung ha ya grī wa'i sku// sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying rngam brjid pa'i sku// spyan gsum zhal bgrad dbang gi mche ba gtsigs// smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar// dbu skra kham nag ral pa gyen du 'khyil// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang gu zil gnon rngams// rngog ma dmar po dbang gi rta skad 'tsher// sbrul rigs bzhi yi sku rgyan phyag zhabs spras// g.yas pas ral gri 'bar ba 'phyar thabs bsnams// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub me yi phung po bsnams// dbang drag me dpung klong 'khyil rin chen spras// sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par ldan// dbang chen gdug pa'i spyan rtse ldog pa yis// snang srid dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud// shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma'i bskal pa 'byung*// snang srid kun 'dar mthu chen drag rtsal 'dul// snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug stong ldir ba yis// srid pa'i che btsan thams cad zil gyis gnon// tshems las drag po'i thog chen phab pa yis// sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog

/zhal nas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khrug cing 'khyil// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la skyin thang phob// khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad tshe re re// thugs rjes dbang chen che btsan dbang du sdud// pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung mi bzad pa// khyod kyi dbang drag phrin las dus la bab// sdang dgra gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog /chos skyong spyi skul ni/ dur khrod rol pa chen po'i gnas mchog nas// bstan la gnod byed gdug pa'i gdan steng na// dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ya// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' nyan mthu rtsal can// legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra// gru 'dzin chen po srid gsum dbang sdud cing*// lha chen sras po tshogs bdag drag shul can// rnal 'byor dgra bla bstan srung yongs kyi gtso// e ka dza ṭī bdud mo ral gcig ma// 'dod khams gtso mo gshin rje yongs kyi lcam// dur khrod bdag po sring mo zhing skyong tshogs// dpal mgon brgyad chu rtsa bdun 'khor dang bcas// lha srin sde brgyad sprul pa yang sprul dang*// pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas// rnam lnga rgyan gyi longs spyod sna tshogs dang*// khyad par rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// dzam+bu ti ba'i bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyen por 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsal 'debs gnyan por 'bul// 'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams zlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// bstan pa dar rgyas phrin las khyod kyis sgrubs// tshe 'dir nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// bsam pa'i don rnams chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis bde legs shing*// lam lnga khyad par sa rnams bgrod byas te// mi mthun bdud kyi tshogs las g.yul rgyal zhing*// rdo rje theg pa'i sa mchog thob par shog

/de nas bsgral las la 'jug ste/ nyin tha mar/ gser skyems ni/ chang phud 'thor la/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod// khyad par rta mgrin lha tshogs mchod// mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yis// nyer dgongs byin rlabs dpal bskyed nas// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// sngon tshe rta mchog rol pa yi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas// dbang drag srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho phud kyis mchod// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa srung mdzad kun gyi gtso// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral dang*// zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi sogs// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas kun// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sogs/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams dang*// gnas bdag kun dang yul bdag kun// gser skyems gtsang mas tshim byas nas// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// byed dang 'khu ldog ma mdzad par// stong grogs gnyan po ci nus mdzod// sa yi phyogs ni 'di nyid ni// sa'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// 'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa// thams cad phud kyis tshim byas nas// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// ru nga phra dog ma mdzad par// stong grogs gnyan po ci nus mdzod// lha yi phyag rgya mi bzod cing*// byer dang 'khu ldog byed pa rnams// gser skyems gtsang mas tshim byas nas// ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs// de nas mnyes pa'i dpang gzugs ni/ brgyud gsum bla ma rigs 'dzin tshogs// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang*// khyad par rta mgrin lha tshogs rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra ste// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra yin// dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra lags// sems can yongs la 'tshe ba byas// mtshams med lnga dang nye ba bsags// nyams pa bdun dang zhing bcu tshang*// 'dis ni sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang*// rdo rje sems dpa' bkrongs pa ste// 'di de sdig pa chen po can// mnar med 'gro ba'i bdag nyid yin// bdag gis snying rje cher bskyed nas// 'jig rten rten 'brel nor rdzas dang*// 'dus byas zas kyi longs spyod byin// sna tshogs thabs kyis bris byas nas// las ngan 'di las bzlog cig ces// yang yang gsol yang ldog ma nyan// des na gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// re zhig thugs kyi btang bar 'tshal// bdag gis ma nyes ma yo zhing*// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pas// de ltar lags par gzung du gsol// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang*// phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bdag la dgongs// gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// bla ma'i sku la 'khu 'khu ba// rgyal ba'i bka' la 'gom 'gom pa// rnal 'byor sku la bsdo bsdo ba// bdag kyang 'phags pa rab mchod cing*// gzhan don ci nus bgyid bsam pas// dgra bgegs 'di yis ma ster ro// spros bral rang bzhin dag pa'i klong*// dbyings kyi thig ler sgom snyam yang*// bar chad rkyen 'dis ma ster ro// bdag gis cung zad ma nyes shing*// rnam pa kun tu ma yo ba// de ltar mkhyen par mdzad nas kyang*// mthu stobs skyed pa'i cho ga mdzod// lha dang gnyis su med par bsgoms// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i grogs mdzod /tshogs tha ma bsgral zhing bstabs te 'bul ba ni/ bsgral chas dang*/ tshogs liṅga bcas bshams la/ nyin dang po rnams la tshogs tha ma dang*/ nyin rjes mar liṅga la gdab las bya ste/ de'ang mngon spyod kyi las dang 'brel bas skabs 'dir bsgral thabs gsum gyis rnam rtog chos nyid du bsgral ba'i bye brag phyi ltar liṅga dgra bgegs su bsgral bar gsum/ tha ma 'tshe ba gsum dang ldan pa'i gyer sgom rgyas par spro dgos pas/ tshogs tha ma dang liṅgar lhan cig tu dmigs te/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'brub khung nag po kha dog cing mthil yangs pa kha khyer rim pa gsum dang ldan zhing*/ 'og phyogs 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba/ phyi nas gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs shing*/ nang zhe sdang gi me dpung 'khrugs pa/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi bshas ra 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su nṛ dang tri las gnod byed dgra bgegs de dag nyam thag cing mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs can/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ e ram̐/ phaṭa ram̐/ dz+wa la ram̐/ nṛ dzaḥtri dzaḥ na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ rig 'dzin zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi= bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis ma rungs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig nṛ yaṃ dzaḥnṛ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥtri yaṃ dzaḥtri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bkug la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing dril bu gsil/ sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgyas bkug cing bstims pas liṅga de dgra bgegs dngos su bsams la/

hūm̐/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis// zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang*// 'khor ba'i nyon mongs rgya dral nas// dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya// sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces de'i snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur bu btab pas kho'i rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsgom/ kho'i tshe lhag rang la thim pas rang nyid tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur par bsams la/ liṅga'i rnam smin gyi lus ral gris dum bur gtubs shing bteg ste/ hūm̐/ zhing gyur thams cad rang bzhin bsgral// sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di// rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes gtor ma la bstab bo// 'dir 'og tu dgos pa'i gtsang lhag zur du bzhag go /de nas zlog sgyur ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la// do nub bzlog pa'i las 'chol gyi// phyir bzlog tshur la zlog par mchi'o// gnyen byas dgra ru song bar mchi'o// bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bsgyur// bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin la// do nub bzlog pa'i las= /phyir bzlog= /gnyen byas= /bzlog go= /bsgyur ro= /bzlog bsgyur= /dus la= /yi dam lha tshogs thams cad la// do nub zlog pa'i las= /phyir bzlog= /gnyen byas= /bzlog go= /bsgyur ro= /bzlog bsgyur= /dus la= /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// do nub zlog pa'i las 'chol gyi// phyir bzlog tshur la bzlog par mchi'o// gnyen byas dgra ru song bar mchi'o// bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bsgyur// bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// zlog gtor la gtor chung phul zhing sman rag bran la/

/yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo 'di// sder mo can gyis snying nas drongs// mche ba can gyis klad nas phug /zhags pa can gyis yan lag bcings// lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms// dril bu can gyis myos su chug /tho ba can gyis mgo nas rdungs// las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded// mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus// yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo 'di// las mkhan rnams kyis zhal du thob// gnam gyi 'ju thag chod la shog /sa yi rten phur thon la shog /don snying lnga po phyung la shog /kha nas khong khrag skyug tu chug /skyob pa'i lha dang phrol la shog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thong*// ye 'drog gsum brgya drug cu thong*// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi thong*// dam nyams las ngan sdig can 'di// lo dang zla bar ma 'jog par// rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston// bcol ba'i las 'di ma byas na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bslus// phyi rabs gsang sngags sun yang phyung*// rig 'dzin bdag gi re ba chad// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po nyams// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig 'gal// thub pa'i bstan srung ming tsam gyur// de bas dam las ma 'da' bar// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// ces dang*/ bh+yoḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po bshig pa zlog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dmod pa zlog /gtsug lag khang chen dkor khang bshig pa zlog /gsang sngags rgyud la dpyas su 'dogs pa zlog /dge 'dun dkor la rlom zhing khyer ba= /'gro ba kun la gnod cing 'tshe ba= /dkar po'i chos la brnag cing dmod pa= /bka' las 'das shing dam nyams khrims nyams= /bdag la gnod par sems dpa'i bsam ngan= /sgrub la bar du gcod par byed pa= /mtshams kyi khongs su 'jug par byed pa= /tshogs kyi yo byad rku zhing 'phrog pa= /ting 'dzin drod la bar du gcod pa= /dngos grub bgegs dang bar du gcod pa=

sogs rgyan gyis spras// dbang chen khrag 'thung rol pa'i zor// thog mtshon dug nad 'tshub ma 'di// dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du brdeg /byad phur chag che bar chad zlog /gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ rbad ta ya rbad ta ya lo ka rbad ta ya phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha/ zlog zlog ces btags pa mang du brjod la brdeg /dul mo brdab cing dmod mo bya/ yar log la rta bro brdung ba ni/ sgo drung du gtor gzhong sbubs la/ e ram̐/ phaṭa ram̐/ dz+wa la ram̐/ nṛ dzaḥ tridzaḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ā be sha ya āḥ hrīḥdamar nag gru gsum 'khyil pa yi// dbang chen dkyil 'khor chen po nas// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /dbang chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing*// dbang gi rta skad tse re re/ khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem// gsang ba'i shug glu kyu ru ru// bskal pa'i glog dmar ljibs si ljib// rdo rje'i thog 'bebs lams se lam/ hūm̐ gis khams gsum dbang du sdud/ phaṭa kyis dregs pa'i bdud dpung sreg /rngam chen sku yi dkyil 'khor nas// dbang chen rus pa'i phung po la// gsod byed byams pa'i bro brdungs pas// zhe sdang me yi tshogs chen bcom// khrag 'thung gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas// sreg bya rak+ta'i chu bo la// rdung byed dbang pos bro brdungs pas// 'dod chags rgya mtsho'i rba klong bcom// dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// ma rig sha yi phung po la// kun mkhyen gsal ba'i bro brdungs pas// gti mug mun pa'i tshogs chen bcom// gtum chen yon tan dkyil 'khor nas// ngar 'dzin dregs pa'i phung po la// bdag med rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas// nga rgyal brag ri'i tshogs chen bcom// 'jigs byed phrin las dkyil 'khor nas// 'gro rgyud ser chen 'khyil ba la// 'dod chen snying rje'i bro brdungs pas// phrag dog 'dod pa'i tshogs chen bcom// ma chags pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor nas// rnam rtog bgegs kyi phung po la// gnyis med rol pa'i bro brdungs pas// gnyis 'dzin gdon gyi tshogs chen bcom// nyon mongs rdul du rlog pa'i bro// nyon mongs steng du da rdungs shig

/rnam rtog phye ru 'thag pa'i bro// rtog pa'i mgo la da rdungs shig /skye med klong du chems se chem// 'gag med klong du khrigs se khrig /dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya nan// dgra bgegs thams cad s+t+waṃ bha ya nan// zhes brjod/ me chu'i rgyas 'debs ni/ hūm̐/ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya// gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya// gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya// drug pa rigs drug sangs rgyas rgya// bdun pa ma mo bdun gyi rgya// brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya// dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya// bcu pa khro bo bcu yi rgya// nga yi rgya las ma 'da' zhig /nang du 'khod nas bshal chu brtan ma'i gtor ma'i mgor blugs te/ tram̐ rat+na trai lokya s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ gtor ma rin po che'i mchod sdong 'dod yon gyi sprin phung zad mi shes par 'phro bar gyur/ hoḥ nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang*/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi dang*/ dkar sham bzhin legs kyi bu mo sman btsun chen mo bzhi ste/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa/ dpal chen po'i pham phab dang sgrub pa po'i stong grogs la 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e skyong ma rnams// 'dir gshegs dam skong phrin las mdzod// bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi// gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi// kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi// brtan ma chen mo khyed rnams kyang*// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas// 'dir gshegs dam skong phrin las mdzod// slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang*// bshes gnyen laṅka dpal brtsegs kyis// rgya yul de ni brtan bzang du// zhing chen 'khrigs pa'i gdan steng du// rnam lnga zhing gi mchod bkram ste// lag tu rdo rje gtad nas ni// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i dam la btags// rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag

/thar pa thob phyir ming yang btags// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// dam tshig bzhin du ma 'da' bar// bod khams skyong zhing srung ba dang*// sgrub pa po yi stong grogs mdzod// bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la// spyi las gyur pa'i nad rnams dang*// rims nad thams cad bzlog pa dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal du ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes gshegs la gtor ma dor ro// mchod bstod bsdus pa dang bcas/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ khro rgyal rngams pa rta mchog dpal// dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las// mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol// rtsa sngags bdun nam nyer gcig tsam/ oṃ dz+ra kro dha kā ya wāk+tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la hoḥ zhes dngos grub blang ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo las// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku// gsung mchog rta skad 'tsher bas 'gro ba 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ces bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren sogs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan bdun/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol dang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// pad+ma gsung gi dpal chen he ru ka'i// drag po'i zor gyi las rim spel ba'i dges// bstan dgra'i tshogs rnams ming tsam mthar byed cing*// bdag sogs lam gyi bar chad zhi gyur cig
